data.gender_notes: Nanak is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Nanak means 'given by God'. This name holds significant importance in Sikhism, where Guru Nanak Dev Ji is the first of the ten Sikh gurus. He is believed to have founded the Sikh religion and set an example of living a righteous life. The name Nanak carries the meaning “Given by God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sikhism tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nanak usually hope their child will grow to embody given by god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name given by the divine
data.etymology: Nanak belongs to the Sikhism linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Given by God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nanak total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
